english.note: Use 預訂 as the all-purpose noun for arranging a service in advance, including travel or accommodation.
Use this broad booking term for an advance hotel, ticket, or transport arrangement when the exact type is not being emphasized.

examples.english: My hotel booking has already been confirmed.
examples.traditional: 我嘅酒店預訂已經確認喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ge3 zau2 dim3 jyu6 deng6 ji5 ging1 kok3 jan6 laa3

examples.english: I made a reservation for my flight to Tokyo.
examples.traditional: 我已經預訂咗去東京嘅機票。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 ging1 jyu6 deng6 zo2 heoi3 dung1 ging1 ge3 gei1 piu3
